author: agent
text: NEEDS DECISION (agent, 2026-10-20): same MSRV question as JMAP-6k5d.2 (comment 2026-10-20 18:24, unanswered). Per 6k5d.1, crate-jmap-chat-mimi-client uses openmls =0.9.1; openmls 0.9.1 and openmls_traits 0.6.0 declare rust-version 1.91.0 (checked in their registry Cargo.toml), but the workspace/CI msrv is 1.88. The GroupInfo check (mimi L414) needs MLS parsing: it decodes the decrypted GroupInfo to read external_senders, and it verifies SignWithLabel(hub_sender.signature_key, "GroupInfoResponseTBS", ...) (draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-06 5.6). Doing it with tls_codec only (MSRV 1.85) would mean hand-writing a GroupInfo parser, which 6k5d.6 already rejected as against 6k5d.1. Options: (A) bump the workspace MSRV to 1.91 (recommended, as on .2); (B) give this crate its own rust-version 1.91 and a second CI job; (C) split: land the Room/create|update|send|unbind and GroupInfo/fetch JMAP bindings plus the L255 last-client predicate (identities as bytes) now at 1.88 with no MLS dep, and move the L414 GroupInfo check to a follow-up once the MSRV is decided. Choices I will make unless told otherwise: the caller supplies the OpenMlsCrypto provider; dev-dep openmls_rust_crypto =0.6.0; VerifyWithLabel is tested against the mlswg crypto-basics.json sign_with_label vectors (suites 1, 2); the full GroupInfoResponse fixture comes from my own pyca/cryptography script, not copied from mimid (AGPL); KeyPackage/* and KeyMaterial/fetch bindings (not in this bead's text) become a follow-up bead.
